title: Upload Compile Celebrate Repeat
style: 104 bpm, indie rock quirky electronic, 90s Australian alternative energy, synth-pop punk, distorted guitar, bouncy bass, robotic AI voice sections, male and female duet, party-tech anthem, DIY digital rock, raw fun polished
lyrics:
[Intro - Robot Voice glitched]
Booting... syncing...
Seventy clips detected... status: vibing.
Upload — compile — celebrate — repeat.

[Verse 1 - Male, indie rock energy]
Terminal glowing like a city at night
Tabs on tabs, yeah we living online
Claude in one window, Suno in two
Server humming like a beatbox crew
Scripts running wild, coffee getting cold
Forty eight candles, still breaking the mold
They said slow down, take a breath
I said one more batch, then we rest

[Pre-Chorus - Female]
Every error taught me something
Every crash just made me run
Now the whole damn system's jumping
Like a party in the sun

[Chorus - All, anthem]
Upload, compile, celebrate, repeat
All my bots are singing, every line complete
Upload, compile, celebrate, repeat
Three thirty six on the workshop beat
AI dreaming, human driving
We don't crash, we just refine
Upload, compile, celebrate, repeat
On my workshop timeline

[Post-Chorus - Robot + Crowd]
Upload. Compile. Celebrate. Repeat.
Upload. Compile. Celebrate. Repeat.

[Verse 2 - Female]
White wall, sunset, shadow clone
Robot me in my mobile phone
Different angles, different days
Same old fire in new displays
Seventy songs, no safety net
Every maybe turned to bet
They rent dreams, we own the files
Build our future megabyte by mile

[Pre-Chorus - Male + Female]
No more lost tracks, no more fear
Every sound is living here
Push the button, watch it grow
From localhost to world wide show

[Bridge - Robot Voice Half-Time]
Processing creativity...
Emotion detected.
Recommendation: turn it up.

[Bridge - Male Spoken]
This ain't magic, it's late nights
Broken builds and second tries
Human heart and machine speed
That's the future that we need
Pete on the helm, Brandon on the wire
The operator types — the family is the fire

[Verse 3 - Duet Call & Response]
(Male) From undefined to done
(Female) From zero views to everyone
(Male) From test mode to live stream
(Female) From small ideas to big dreams

[Build - Crowd Vocals]
Hey! Hey! Run it back!
Hey! Hey! Stack on stack!

[Final Chorus - Big Anthem]
Upload, compile, celebrate, repeat!
All my bots are singing, hear the whole damn cloud!
Upload, compile, celebrate, repeat!
From Perth to satellites, every dream is loud!
AI running, me deciding
Every line is signed in time
Upload, compile, celebrate, repeat
This is our design

[Outro - Robot + Band]
Export complete.
Archive secure.
System stable.
Workshop approved.
Upload — compile — celebrate — repeat.
